# openinfra_elastic_ip (Resource)

A static public IP on a kind: NatGateway (kube-ovn IptablesEIP) — the AWS Elastic IP, optionally associated with a private workload (fip 1:1 or per-port dnat). Requires the kube-ovn CNI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `nat_gateway` (String) The kind: NatGateway that hosts this address.

### Optional

- `address` (String) A specific public IP from the external range. Omit to auto-allocate.
- `external_network` (String) The external network the address is drawn from. Must match the gateway's.
- `mode` (String) Association mode when target is set: fip (1:1 whole-IP, bidirectional) or dnat (per-port, needs ports).
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `ports` (Attributes List) For mode=dnat: the port forwards from this address to target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `target` (String) The private IP to associate with. The target MUST sit on a PUBLIC kind: Subnet (private=false). Omit for an unassociated EIP.

### Read-Only

- `allocated_address` (String) The allocated public IP (when address is auto-assigned).
- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `external` (String) Public-facing port.
- `internal` (String) Target port on the workload.

Optional:

- `protocol` (String) tcp (default) or udp.
